description: Source code for media GPU channel management, including implementation of DecoderProvider and MediaGpuChannel classes, handling GPU video decoding and IPC communication.

classes.name: DecoderProviderImpl
classes.description: Implements GPU accelerated video decoder provider and observes command buffer stub destruction.

methods.name: CreateAcceleratedVideoDecoder
methods.description: Creates and initializes a GPU video decoder, with platform-specific handling for Android.

methods.name: OnWillDestroyStub
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the command buffer stub is about to be destroyed.

methods.name: MediaGpuChannel
methods.description: Manages GPU channel and binds command buffer media receivers.

methods.name: BindCommandBufferMediaReceiver
methods.description: Binds a command buffer stub to a media GPU channel, adding a decoder provider.
